column4: PROVISIONAL: Bangali torovirus N, 211 aa, Met-initiated, 86.8% identical over its first 166 residues to the 167 aa torovirus N and carrying a 44-residue C-terminal extension. It spans a full-length N end to end, so it is not a fragment. No paper gives a length for this virus N, so the window was widened to 215 on this measurement alone.
